title: {p} & Potato Skillet
steps: Dice the {s} small and pan-fry in oil for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden and tender, then move to a clean plate.

Pat the {p} dry, season with the {spice} and salt, and sear 3 to 4 minutes a side. Check the thickest part with a thermometer: the USDA safe minimum for steak is 145°F / 63°C. A lower doneness is your choice and carries more risk.
Rest the {p} 3 to 5 minutes, then slice, and cook the {v} in the same pan until soft.
Toss everything together with the {sauce} and serve hot.
tip: Use more veg than potato, slice the steak thin so a little goes a long way, and go light on the sauce.
